iterations.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A studio concept sheet for a fictional 3D spacecraft game model. Image 1 is the original pixel-art shape and color reference; preserve its geometry. A low elongated rectangular grey metal body, about three times as long as wide, on a shallow chamfered base. A low sloping roof covers the rear half. Two separate small brick-red rectangular pieces sit side by side across the front deck with a gap between them. Slim bronze-brown strips are seated along the two long sides. Small opaque pale grey-blue inset on the front end and a brown rear face. Both red pieces face the same direction. Broad quiet steel surfaces, a few fitted maintenance covers and fasteners, restrained seam grime, scratches and small dents. One large elevated three-quarter view with a smaller consistent side view and top view of the exact same object. Charcoal background, neutral lighting, no lettering. Keep the simple original proportions and color placement; avoid extra appendages or dense panel grids.
iterations.verdict: Useful primitive/material study but insufficient construction detail; red blocks incorrectly longitudinal in plan. Legacy controls transverse pair, user concept supersedes detail direction.

user_references.provenance: User-supplied ImageGen concept in this task
user_references.verdict: Preferred fitted construction and depth. Keep legacy low layered hull/transverse red pair instead of tandem bridges; no new emission/glazing or dense plate grid.

glb_feedback.verdict: Actual GLB retained low body, aft roof and transverse red pair, but upper side walls were bare with inherited cap-normal waves. Add four conformal shoulder covers and physical planar side-wall normals.
Expanded fittings exceeded65000 triangles. Reduce planar added-cover/rib tessellation, preserving original body/dent density. Final61322triangles/four batches/one material.

Actual comparison found reversed0/4 side/rear cameras and excessive top visibility in12/28. Use estimated azimuth180degrees and end elevation0.12. Saved native and independent GLB were genuinely regenerated/verified afterward; client heading mapping remains uncalibrated.

Low grey layered hull, bronze side strips, transverse red pair and sloped aft roof retained. Six framed side banks, four conformal shoulder covers, roof/foredeck louvers and cover bands add real depth.197 editable identities and196 contacts retained. Hidden joints and small fittings remain interpretations; preview is darker/cooler, and user concept is richer than this game-budget translation.
